reviews.body: Thanks, lint and format are green. The editor textarea now meets the same refusal as other rich-text editors, so a write the editor would merge no longer reports `ok: true`. Merging; the merge queue runs the benchmark on this path.

comments.body: Thanks for your first pull request to Reticle! A maintainer aims to review within two days. Before then, `pnpm verify` locally catches most of what CI will, and [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/reticlehq/reticle/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) explains the rest. If CI does not start, a maintainer needs to approve it for first-time contributors; that is normal.

Thanks, the fix is right: the editor textarea now meets the same refusal as other rich-text editors, so a write that the editor would merge no longer reports `ok: true`.

CI fails on lint: 8 `curly` errors in `adapters/realm/browser/src/actions/value-input.ts` (lines 27, 31, 74–76, 93, 102, 108). AGENTS.md rule 17: when you change a file, add the braces to every `if` in it. Run `npx eslint --fix adapters/realm/browser/src/actions/value-input.ts`, then `npx eslint src --prune-suppressions` in `adapters/realm/browser`, and `pnpm format`. Then `pnpm verify` should pass.
Thanks, lint is green now. One check left: `format-check` fails. Run `pnpm format` and push; then I can approve.
